name: bell
description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: One continuous silhouette integrates the top hanger to avoid doubled seams. Straight side walls meet softened shoulders and a straight lower lip; the separate clapper remains recognizable. Vertical bounds y=2.5..21.5 are centered. Review study; not owner-approved.
